title: JSFL: document.library.items missing symbolType field on symbol items
description: In packages/authoring-ui/src/jsfl/runtime.ts, the JsflLibraryItem interface is missing the symbolType field ('movie clip', 'button', 'graphic'). The Flash 8 JSFL LibraryItem exposes symbolType for symbol items. The model's Symbol type already has symbolType. Fix: add symbolType to the JsflLibraryItem interface and map it from the model's sym.symbolType for symbol-type items.
